segments.text: Ok so this is the quickstart page for AG2 with Angular, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, the backend step is just this callout, no code.
And no page gives the commands to start the agent and the runtime.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
This part, the AG2 agent and the runtime server, wasn't on the page, so I had to add it myself.
Moving on to the demo. Following the page, the chat should talk to an AG2 agent, but umm, there's nothing behind it, it only works with my own backend.
So basically, the page says connect your AG2 backend, but it never shows one.
There's no AG2 agent, no runtime server, and the ag-ui client install is missing, so you have to guess all of it.
That's it for this one, kindly look into this issue.
